Product OverviewIn Taiwan, there is a growing emphasis on art education, yet a significant gap in students’ understanding and exploration of color concepts. Cailar & Carla aimed to bridge this gap by creating an interactive learning product to introduce elementary students to the fundamentals of color theory.
Cailar & Carla is an interactive color learning product designed for elementary students (ages 7–11) to explore color theory through hands-on play. By integrating a plush tactile controller and an accompanying physical picture book with a gamified mobile app, children can capture colors from their real-world environment to solve challenges. This multimodal approach addresses the lack of engaging, depth-oriented color education in current curriculums.

Product OverviewMany strategy games on the market either require significant time investment or are overly simplistic. As a result, people with limited time often choose other game genres for relaxation, leading them to avoid strategy games altogether.
Slime Strategy is a strategy game that combines a compelling storyline with easy accessibility, allowing players to learn the game mechanics in just 5 minutes and complete it within a total playtime of 30 minutes.
